paper_title: The search for low-mass axion dark matter with ABRACADABRA-10cm
notes: Broadband axion DM search constraining g_agamma over 0.41-8.27 neV (100 kHz - 2 MHz). Strongest limit g_agamma < 3.2e-11 GeV^-1 at ma ~ 2.99 neV. Local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed (Standard Halo Model, v0=220 km/s). Limit curve only available in Fig. 4; numerical data points approximate except the quoted best limit.
